points.description: States that C++ programs begin execution at the main function (main()), in any wording.
points.partial_credit: Award about 2 to 3 marks for a related but incomplete statement, e.g. says it starts at the beginning of the program or at a function/entry point without naming main.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying execution starts at main (main function, main(), 'within main'), however briefly or informally. Part marks for vague answers like 'at the first function' or 'the entry point' without naming main. No marks for unrelated answers, e.g. header files or the compiler. Extra correct detail is fine.
